name: phospholipase C gamma 1

function.text: PLCG1 encodes 1-phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate phosphodiesterase gamma-1. Annotated molecular activities include C-type glycerophospholipase activity and lysophospholipase C activity. It participates in calcium-mediated signaling and cell migration.
